notes.title: Free!
notes.content:
[h1]Hide and go boom will be set free[/h1]

In about one week, Hide and go boom will no longer cost money.

This is being done in an attempt to boost the player base.

Thank you very much all who bought the game and supported the development.

Also, Hide and go boom will no longer be in early access.

notes.title: Game configuration tool and 8 player limit
notes.content:
A new game configuration tool has been released, so you can now configure the game to your liking.

[h1]Things to configure:[/h1]
Level size
Max players (increased to 8 players)
Crate percentage
Layers in insanity mode
Up to 4 player split screen.

[h1]Other:[/h1]
Increased control while jumping

notes.title: Play on Mac
notes.content:
[h1]Mac version released[/h1]
As promised, the Mac version of the game is now available. Get it now for a friend who has been left out.

Also, don't forget to join us on Discord.

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join us on Discord to have a chat about where the game is going or to find people to play with:
https://discord.gg/ghCNZFP

notes.title: Discord server and better controller support.
notes.content:
[h1]Discord[/h1]
Join us on Discord to have a chat about where the game is going or to find people to play with:
https://discord.gg/ghCNZFP


[h1]Improved controller support[/h1]
Today I have posted a small update to improve controller support.

You are now able to join a game without using mouse and keyboard.

Coming early next week is a build for OS x, so you friends with Macs can join the fun.

If you have wishes for features, feel free to ask here or talk to me on Discord.

notes.title: Linux support
notes.content:
Just a quick update to inform you that [b]Hide and go boom[/b] now supports Linux(experimentally).

If you experience any problems, don't hesitate to contact me and I will do my best to squash the problem.

/Rasmus

notes.title: Hide and go boom has released!
notes.content:
Hide and go boom  has officially been released to the public.
Grab your buddies and join the action.

Huge thanks to all the people who helped test the game before Early Access release, I couldn't have done it without you.

Should you run into any issues, please leave a comment and I will do my best to solve it right away.

Don't hesitate to suggest features, any input is welcome.

Enjoy

/Rasmus
